title: Tooling: 1.45x faster complete R439 omission replay
body:
PR1017's R439 omission atlas executes 5,563 complete literal mutant replays. This opt-in tool packs sixteen independent executions into integer bit lanes, reducing the complete audit's median from **2.167 s to 1.490 s, 1.45x faster**, on macOS arm64 CPython 3.14.8. All 5,563 full 661-by-661 maps and every predecessor certificate field match. No new kappa is claimed.

Only `research/omission-lanes-seed92/` is added. The frozen checker remains unchanged; three hash-bound source adaptations in memory feed it packed literal maps and enforce map/row coverage. Every prefix/suffix gate, symbolic input, output row, factor comparison, Boolean witness and existing control remains checked. No factor-derived mutant maps or cached results are used.

Reproduce with standard-library Python 3.10+:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/omission-lanes-seed92/verify.py
```

Expected status: `PASS_PACKED_OMISSION_EQUIVALENCE`. Use `replay.py` for the accelerated audit alone or add `--benchmark` to `verify.py` for five alternating complete-audit timings per mode. `BENCHMARK.json` retains every timing, interpreter details and exact implementation hashes, including the slower 64-lane experiment. There is no batch-size optimality or Linux speed claim.

Verification passed for all full matrices, 1,564 short/boundary words at five batch sizes, seven inherited controls and thirteen new controls. New controls cover high input bits, duplicated/extra/missing lanes, missing helper rows and separate source corruption. The registered Python 3.12 replay, optimized Python 3.11 run outside the checkout, five selected-record tests and selected-source bindings pass. Linux CI is separate. Native/hosting, full selected cold replay and Lean were not run.

OS assignment seed **92**, verification engineering. Exact research base **cd91ac8e2652bfee6bf09da3b8724253bcf78f5f**. Rebased onto **410026dc5513b87db92ae98571d1d5984c69a983** after confirming all five live input bytes and the replay tooling were unchanged. Git blob/SHA256 pins and historical selected #1094 context are in `SOURCES.json`. Final overlap search at 00:45:48 UTC covered 792 open PRs and 149 discussion records with complete pagination; it found only the predecessor for the declared search terms. The local claim is completed and released.

Credit woklerx's PR1017 atlas/interpreter, Sricharan Vagvala's PR967 word, DreamingOfClouds' PR589 supplier, eumemic's PR555/543 lineage and the retained predecessor notices. Prepared for Sagar Thakrar with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in selection, implementation, verification and writing. New material is Apache-2.0. One agent; no independent human review or full multiplication theorem proof is claimed.
